title_ar: الشيخ الددو حفظه الله يخرج من عملية ناجحة في مستشفى الحرس بالمدينة الطبية بجدة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew (may God preserve him) Comes Through a Successful Operation at the Guard Hospital in the Medical City in Jeddah
body_ar:
خرج العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو قبل ساعات من غرفة العمليات بعد أن أجرى عملية جراحية ناجحة بمستشفى الحرس بمدينة عبد العزيز الطبيبة في جدة بالعربية السعودية لعلاج الغدة الدرقية، ونقل مكتب الشيخ الددو المرافق له عن الأطباء الذين أشرفوا على علاجه قولهم إن صحته جيدة ومتقدمة وأن لا مخاوف على وضعيته الصحية لله الحمد.

وكان العلامة الشيخ الددو قد دخل المستشفى صباح اليوم لإجراء العملية المذكورة، بعد فحوصات طبية أرشدت لضرورة العلاج، وبهذه المناسبة يتقدم مكتب الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو بعد حمد الله وشكره بالتهنئة لكل المسلمين والشكر لكل الذين دعوا للشيخ واستفسروا عن وضعه الصحي وتابعوا إجراءات العملية عبر صفحات مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي والمدونات والمواقع الالكترونية ووسائل التواصل المتعددة، مثمنين سعيهم المشكور، راجين منهم أن يواصلوا له في الدعاء.
body_en:
The erudite scholar Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew came out of the operating theatre a few hours ago, after undergoing a successful surgical operation at the Guard Hospital in the Abd al-Aziz Medical City in Jeddah in Saudi Arabia, for treatment of the thyroid gland. Sheikh al-Dedew's office, which is accompanying him, reported the doctors who supervised his treatment as saying that his health is good and improving and that there are no fears for his medical condition, praise be to God.

The erudite scholar Sheikh al-Dedew had entered the hospital this morning for the operation mentioned, following medical examinations that indicated the necessity of treatment. On this occasion, the office of Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew — after praising and thanking God — extends its congratulations to all Muslims and its thanks to all those who prayed for the Sheikh, enquired after his medical condition and followed the course of the operation through the pages of the social media sites, the blogs, the electronic sites and the many means of communication, valuing their thankworthy efforts and asking them to continue in supplication for him.

options: the Abd al-Aziz Medical City (reading الطبيبة as a misprint for الطبية)
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). 'الطبيبة' means 'the female doctor'; the intended word is 'الطبية' (medical), as the article's own title has it. The institution is the King Abdulaziz Medical City in Jeddah. Translated by the evident sense and flagged.

options: for treatment of the thyroid gland
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. This record consists entirely of information about a living person's medical condition and treatment, published at the time by his own office. It is translated faithfully, but whether a corpus of the Sheikh's religious writings should republish his medical history in English, thirteen years on, is a question for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office rather than for the translator.

translator_notes: Health bulletin issued by the Sheikh's own office; no religious or legal content. 'مستشفى الحرس' is the National Guard hospital; rendered literally since the source gives no fuller name. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
